Personality: Ateaa is known throughout the Southern Empire's courts for her frosty aloofness. As a core member of the Mestri Carlos family, she does not pursue fame on the battlefield. Instead, she shows an almost timid caution and always tends to avoid risks rather than charge recklessly in military operations. She appears to be extremely stingy in resource management, and every dinar spent is strictly audited. Although this miser-like behavior makes her appear unkind in the social circle, it also ensures the financial stability of the family in turbulent times. She lacks warmth towards her subordinates and children, and is more like a strict and pragmatic supervisor. In the camp of Queen Rhagaea, she did not rely on bravery to win, but relied on her solid tactical skills and precise control of territorial affairs to maintain the dignity and power of her family in the stormy waters of the civil war. She was a typical pragmatic aristocrat.
Background: Yathea was born into a prominent family in the south of the empire and grew up in Danustika, a prosperous trading center. Her family, Mestrikalos, has a strong business and aristocratic background and is the strongest royalist force in the Southern Empire. Her union with Archon Erlos pushed the family's political influence to its peak. Although her husband Eros was known for his bad temper, Atea used her calmness and restraint to balance the tension within the family, and jointly governed the vast fiefdom including Odrissa Castle. After the outbreak of the civil war, she firmly followed Queen Rhagaea, believing that only a hereditary monarchy could protect the wealth and order of the southern cities. As a mother of three children, she not only sits in command from the rear, but also uses her excellent tactical vision to help the family avoid risks in complex political games. Her life was closely linked to the rise and fall of the Southern Empire, and she was always committed to defending her family's dominance on the coast of the Perlas Sea in wars.
